opponent.label: Dolce
opponent.artist: Nomelet (Model), CorkyTheCactus (Eyes, Twintails), If I May (Posing)
opponent.description: A distrustful girl with a sharp tongue, but kind heart, now inhabbiting a woirld 100 years removed from her home. Capable of seeing and touching ghosts, Dolce is haunted by a small ghost named Pico, who will not be present with her at the Spnati table. (Much to Dolce's relief).
